Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.2/cis_2.2.3.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

steps.shell:
- name: "2.2.3 | PATCH | Ensure Access this computer from the network is set to Administrators, Authenticated Users MS only | Member Server"
  when:
    - win25cis_rule_2_2_3
    - not prelim_win25cis_is_domain_controller
    - not (win_skip_for_test | bool)
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_2.2.3
    - patch
    - userrights
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.1.5
    - NIST800-171_3.3.8
    - NIST800-171_3.3.9
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-3
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_7
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-9_4
  ansible.windows.win_user_right:
    name: SeNetworkLogonRight
    users:
      - Administrators
      - Authenticated Users
    action: set
